meta.title: Vendor Clone: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Switch between a tenant on a plan below Growth and a tenant on Growth because no tenant IDs are provided and plan settings cannot be changed or asserted.
Execute Vendor Clone to clone an active vendor because no catalog step performs the clone action.
Verify that the clone succeeds on the Growth tenant because no catalog step observes the resulting cloned event.
